info.name: Health Check API Tests
info.description: Test cases for health check and system status endpoints

item.name: Health Check
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test('Response has healthy status', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.status).to.equal('healthy'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('timestamp'); }); pm.test('Response time is acceptable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });

item.name: Health Check - Multiple Requests
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); }); pm.test('Consistent response format', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('timestamp'); }); pm.test('Timestamp is recent', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); const timestamp = new Date(json.timestamp); const now = new Date(); const diff = Math.abs(now - timestamp); pm.expect(diff).to.be.below(5000); });

item.name: Health Check - OPTIONS Request
item.tests: pm.test('Status code is 200 or 405', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 405]); }); pm.test('CORS headers present', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')).to.not.be.null; });
